title: Role assumption unresolved-site baseline
description: Per-system-role counts of reachable unresolved (any role) role-assumption sites and of child-process entries inheriting SYSTEM_ROLE, ratcheted by the role-assumption-reachability gate (scripts/analyze_role_assumptions.ts). Counts only, never site paths.

child_process_entries.description: Per-system-role count of child-process entries that inherit SYSTEM_ROLE. Optional: when absent the child-process ratchet is off.
